recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Reinstating the original STU3 precondition-extension example would conflict with later Observation and extension-pack decisions and would make the current R6 guidance less accurate.
issue_request: FHIR-17578 was a Published STU3 FHIR-core Observation change request resolved Persuasive. It asked to add Observation Notes guidance explaining how other observations, codes, components, or precondition-style context can provide additional context that may alter the semantics or interpretation of an Observation.
initial_application: The issue was applied before this reconciliation by commit 1c6e2d841cd2, which added the Observation #refine section to source/observation/observation-notes.xml. Observation is active in source/fhir.ini, so the notes file is in current build scope.
additional_context: OO minutes for 2018-08-02 record the GF#17578 motion and 8-0-2 vote. Later Published issue FHIR-18310 revised the same section, changing the second option from translations to additional codes, reversing the oxygen-saturation example order, replacing the explicit precondition-extension example with grouping or extension guidance, and adding an implementer-feedback note. Later R6 work added Observation.interpretationContext, and the extension-pack observation-precondition definition now directs use of Observation.interpretationContext after R5. The combined branch already includes the FHIR-18310 reconciliation that aligns the third bullet with that current mechanism.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit is needed because source/observation/observation-notes.xml still has the #refine guidance requested by FHIR-17578: use the most specific code, use additional codes, and use related Observations or Observation.interpretationContext when context is needed to understand interpretation.

related_jiras.note: Revised the FHIR-17578 #refine section after ballot reconciliation and is already represented on the combined branch.
Updated the observation-precondition extension in the extension pack and made it version-specific through R5.
Added Observation.interpretationContext as the current core element for critical preceding or concurrent context.
